event.text: The CAD play UI loaded successfully!

`bun run dev:cad` works again. Here’s what was wrong and what changed.

### Root causes
1. **Wrong `three` path** — Vite pointed at `ui/react/node_modules/three`, which doesn’t exist; it’s hoisted to the repo root.
2. **CAD packages not in the root workspace** — Only `cad/js` was listed, so `brepjs` / `brepjs-opencascade` never landed in `node_modules`.
3. **Monolithic playground renderer** — CAD play imported `@semio-tech/framework-playground-renderer-react`, which pulled in all puzzle WASM (2d/3d/5d) and broke build/tests.

### Fixes
| Area | Change |
|------|--------|
| `cad/js/renderer/play/vite.config.ts` & `vitest.config.ts` | Resolve `three` from `node_modules/three`; add `brepjs` to `optimizeDeps` |
| Root `package.json` | Register `cad/js/core`, `kernel/brepjs`, `machine/stately`, `query`, `renderer` as workspaces (replacing `cad/js`) |
| `framework/playground/renderer/react/` | Split **`shell.tsx`** (playground chrome) from **`index.tsx`** (puzzle hosts) |
| `cad/js/renderer/play/main.tsx` | Import from `@semio-tech/framework-playground-renderer-react/shell` |
| `ui/styling/vite-elements-assets.ts` | Point `/shell` and `/boot` aliases at `shell.tsx` |

### Verified
- Dev server: **http://127.0.0.1:6020/** — Spatial R3F Play UI loads (catalog, panes, toolbar).
- `bun nx run @semio-tech/cad-js-renderer:test` — **33/33** passed.
- `bun ./script.ts build` in `cad/js/renderer` — production build succeeds (incl. brepjs WASM).

After pulling, run **`bun install`** once so workspace packages and `brepjs` resolve.

*(Repo MCP wasn’t available in this session, so no ticket was opened/closed via MCP.)*
